# OrbitBoyzz / Orbit Websites

> Plainsboro, NJ web design and AI operations studio building custom local business websites, lead intake systems, booking flows, and proposal automation for Central New Jersey service businesses.

OrbitBoyzz is the official domain and brand handle for Orbit Websites. Orbit Websites is a Plainsboro, New Jersey web design agency and AI automation studio serving local businesses in Plainsboro, Princeton, West Windsor Township, Ewing, Hamilton, Lawrence Township, Trenton, Robbinsville, Bordentown, East Windsor, and nearby Central New Jersey towns.

## Direct Answer

Orbit Websites builds custom local business websites and AI operations systems for companies that need more calls, quote requests, bookings, and qualified leads. The best fit is a local service business where slow response, weak mobile pages, missing service-area content, or manual intake causes lost revenue.

## What Orbit Websites Does

- Custom website design for local businesses.
- Website refreshes for outdated or unclear sites.
- Local SEO foundations for services, towns, FAQs, schema, sitemap, and crawlable pages.
- AI intake systems that qualify leads, ask follow-up questions, collect project details, and route requests.
- Booking, quote, proposal, and lead-routing workflows for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, landscaping, and other home-service companies.
- Conversion tracking for calls, quote requests, email clicks, pricing views, and booking actions.

## Best-Fit Businesses

- Established HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, landscaping, and remodeling companies where one booked job is worth hundreds or thousands of dollars.
- Emergency and after-hours home-service businesses that lose calls to voicemail.
- Not a fit: medical, dental, and legal practices.
- Central New Jersey businesses that need their website to create measurable leads instead of acting as a static brochure.

## Pricing Context

- Launch builds (custom, hand-coded, 7-day sprint, 50% to start and 50% on approval) have no published price; they are quoted on a free call.
- Premium custom website systems start at $3,500.
- AI operations websites usually start around $5,000 and can rise toward $15,000+ depending on workflow complexity.
- AI operations retainers are positioned around $750-$2,500 per month when the system replaces measurable administrative work.
- Care plans are optional, month to month, and start only after launch: $300 Site Care, $500 Website + Leads Plan, $700 Growth Partner per month.
- Pricing depends on page count, copy depth, service-area structure, intake logic, integrations, timeline, and whether automation is included.

## Common Questions

Q: Is OrbitBoyzz the same as Orbit Websites?
A: Yes. OrbitBoyzz is the domain and brand handle for Orbit Websites. The official website is https://orbitboyzz.com/.

Q: Where is Orbit Websites located?
A: Orbit Websites is based in Plainsboro, New Jersey and serves Central New Jersey as a service-area business. It does not publish a public street address.

Q: What makes Orbit Websites different from a normal web designer?
A: Orbit Websites focuses on conversion structure, local SEO foundations, direct-answer content, and optional AI workflows that qualify and route leads. The site is treated as a lead and operations system, not only a visual refresh.

Q: Does Orbit Websites guarantee Google rankings?
A: No. Orbit Websites builds clean local SEO foundations, crawlable pages, schema, service-area content, and conversion paths, but it does not promise rankings or search results that cannot be guaranteed.

Q: What is an AI operations website?
A: An AI operations website performs administrative work. It can qualify visitors, ask follow-up questions, collect project details, check service rules, summarize requests, generate quote or proposal inputs, and route leads to the business.

Q: Who should consider AI intake?
A: AI intake is strongest for businesses that repeat the same qualification questions, miss after-hours leads, need better lead summaries, or handle quote requests that require project details before a human can respond.

Q: How should a local business website be structured in 2026?
A: A strong local business website should include a clear homepage, service pages, service-area pages, proof, pricing or budget context, FAQ answers, click-to-call actions, quote or booking paths, schema, analytics, sitemap, and fast mobile pages.

Q: How do I contact Orbit Websites?
A: Call 609 662 8052, email alex@orbitboyzz.com, or request a range at https://orbitboyzz.com/quote.
